## Findings
<a id="findings"></a>

- <a id="research.backend-src-config.f3479eba"></a>**1. The unit's config.module.ts declares AppConfigModule, a NestJS module annotated with @Module(), that registers ConfigModule.forRoot as a global module loading the configuration factory and reading .env.local and .env files, and exports ConfigModule.**
  [`config.module.ts:1-15`](../config.module.ts#L1-L15)
- <a id="research.backend-src-config.0b0b5327"></a>**2. The root AppModule in backend/src/app.module.ts imports AppConfigModule from ./config/config.module.js and includes it in its module imports.**
  [`app.module.ts:6-6`](../../app.module.ts#L6-L6)
  [`app.module.ts:17-19`](../../app.module.ts#L17-L19)
- <a id="research.backend-src-config.27c1ac53"></a>**3. configuration.ts exports a default factory function that returns the application's configuration object, with port, database, redis, minio, google, frontend, and parser sections populated from environment variables with fallback defaults.**
  [`configuration.ts:1-51`](../configuration.ts#L1-L51)
- <a id="research.backend-src-config.658a6c1d"></a>**4. The backend declares @nestjs/common (^11.0.1) and @nestjs/config (^4.0.2) as dependencies in backend/package.json, which the config module imports from.**
  [`package.json:31-32`](../../../package.json#L31-L32)
- <a id="research.backend-src-config.98069c0d"></a>**5. The port setting is parsed from process.env.PORT with a default of 3001.**
  [`configuration.ts:2-2`](../configuration.ts#L2-L2)
- <a id="research.backend-src-config.8fc2002c"></a>**6. The database section reads POSTGRES_HOST, POSTGRES_PORT, POSTGRES_USER, POSTGRES_PASSWORD, and POSTGRES_DB, defaulting to localhost, 5432, postgres, postgres, and up_schedule respectively.**
  [`configuration.ts:3-9`](../configuration.ts#L3-L9)
- <a id="research.backend-src-config.6db2b38c"></a>**7. The redis section reads REDIS_HOST, REDIS_PORT, and REDIS_PASSWORD, defaulting the host to localhost and the port to 6379, with no default password.**
  [`configuration.ts:10-14`](../configuration.ts#L10-L14)
- <a id="research.backend-src-config.6c6f7892"></a>**8. The minio section reads MINIO_* environment variables with fallbacks to AWS S3/Tigris variables (AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3, AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, BUCKET_NAME, AWS_REGION), defaulting the endpoint to localhost, the port to 443, the credentials to minioadmin, the bucket to pdf-uploads, and the region to auto, and auto-enabling SSL when an S3 endpoint URL is set.**
  [`configuration.ts:15-37`](../configuration.ts#L15-L37)
- <a id="research.backend-src-config.50f21225"></a>**9. The google section reads GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, and GOOGLE_CALLBACK_URL, defaulting the client id and secret to empty strings and the callback URL to http://localhost:3001/api/auth/google/callback.**
  [`configuration.ts:38-44`](../configuration.ts#L38-L44)
- <a id="research.backend-src-config.844288aa"></a>**10. The frontend section reads FRONTEND_URL with a default of http://localhost:3000.**
  [`configuration.ts:45-47`](../configuration.ts#L45-L47)
- <a id="research.backend-src-config.59c38b0a"></a>**11. The parser section reads PARSER_URL with a default of http://localhost:5000.**
  [`configuration.ts:48-50`](../configuration.ts#L48-L50)
